'''Metal Cyclone''' (メタルサイクロン, ''Metaru Saikuron'', '''Metal Cyclone''') is a [[:Category:Metal Enemies|Metal]] enemy and [[:Category:Cyclones|Cyclone]] introduced in [[Attack on Titanium (Insane)|Sweet Irony]]. {{Enemy Info |name = Metal Cyclone |image = E 071.png |appearance = [[Attack on Titanium (Insane)|Sweet Irony]]
'''ZL''': [[Groundscraper|Sub-chapter 11 - Groundscraper]] |money drop = 3,000¢ - 11,850¢ }} ==Enemy== Similarly to other [[:Category:Cyclones|Cyclone]]s, this very slow enemy attacks non-stop and deals extreme damage, but has a tiny range of 65. It takes only 1 damage from non-[[Critical Hit|Critical]] attacks like all Metal enemies yet has more than triple the health of [[Sir Metal Seal]], requiring a lot of [[Critical Hit]]s to defeat. Fortunately, Metal Cyclone does have a very high knockback count, making it easy to keep at bay if enough damage is dealt to it. ==Strategy== Depending on the support, you may have to reserve only a few [[:Category:Anti-Metal Cats|anti-Metal]] specialists to take it down. When using [[:Category:Critical Hit Cats|Critters]] like [[Jurassic Cat (Rare Cat)|Jurassic Cat Sitter]] that value quantity over quality, it's important to back them with [[:Category:Crowd-Controller-class Cats|crowd-control units]] so they could at least attack it with impunity. |Element = Metal }} {{UnitViewer|enemy}} ==Gallery== Metal Cyclone(bcp).png|Metal Cyclone's Enemy Guide entry in [[The Battle Cats POP!]] IdleMetalCyclone.gif|Metal Cyclone's moving animation Ciclone.png|Metal Cyclone before it was implemented Medal 022.png|Metal Cyclone on the ''Storm of Steel'' [[Meow Medals|Meow Medal]] 071 e.png|Metal Cyclone's spritesheet File:MetalCyclonePOP.png|Metal Cyclone's Spritesheet (3DS) ==Trivia== *Metal Cyclone existed in the game data for an indeterminate length of time before it was implemented in [[Version 3.0 Update|Version 3.0]], hence why it is the fourth [[:Category:Cyclones|Cyclone]] in the [[Enemy Release Order]] despite being the fifth released, coming after [[Divine Cyclone]], and why [[Oncoming Maelstrom (Expert)|Wrath of Heaven]]'s ID comes before [[Attack on Titanium (Insane)|Sweet Irony]]'s in spite of that. **Before Metal Cyclone was implemented, it appeared noticeably higher above the ground, floating at the same altitude as the previous Cyclones - as shown in the gallery above. ***The Metal Cyclone in [[The Battle Cats POP!]] still has this appearence. *Metal Cyclone is the only Cyclone to close its eye when it is knocked back. *Metal Cyclone has the highest health, shortest range and fastest attack rate of all [[:Category:Metal Enemies|Metal Enemies]]. ==Reference== *https://battlecats-db.com/enemy/073.html ---- {{EnemyNav|Dark Cyclone|Nimue}} ---- {{Enemies}} [[Category:Enemy Units]] [[Category:Metal Enemies]] [[Category:Event Enemies]] [[Category:Zero Legends Enemies]] [[Category:Area Attack Enemies]] [[Category:Cyclones]]
